summary: Former Bradley County lookout at 1,100 ft; the Tennessee list marks it removed, and no history source was found.

facts.status_note: The Tennessee lookout list marks the tower as removed. It is not on the 2014 list of extant Division of Forestry towers.

events.note: The Tennessee list marks the tower removed. It gives no removal date.

evidence.supports: List entry: Candies Creek, 1,100 ft, Bradley, removed
2014 list covers extant Tennessee Division of Forestry towers
evidence.quote: Extant Tennessee Fire Towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: The 2014 list includes N4AOW Tower in Bradley County; Candies Creek is absent from it

sources.title: TN lookout tower: BRT001 Candies Creek

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Brief status (gone), county (Bradley) and elevation (1,100 ft / 335.3 m) match the list. Two searches and the cached pages found no build date, builder, design, height, staffing or history for the Candies Creek tower, and no source describes the site today. The story is short, about 105 words of body text, because nothing more is in the sources; hold or shorten at editor's discretion. The 2014 list excludes Candies Creek: a search of the cached NRHP text finds no 'Candies' match, and the story says so without inferring a removal date. The story no longer says the Tennessee Landforms list records every site with coordinates, because the pages read do not show that.
